shortDescription: The World Bank Thursday said it has approved $200 million in additional funding to help Colombia respond to and recover from the August 10 earthquake that left hundreds dead.

children: The World Bank Thursday said it has approved $200 million in additional funding to help Colombia respond to and recover from the August 10
Funds are additional to $200 million already disbursed
Colombian finance minister says funding demonstrates the bank's confidence in Colombia and its government
Funds will go to reconstruction needs, disaster risk management
The United Nations Development Program last week estimated that the 7.4 magnitude earthquake caused around $14 billion in damage
Colombian authorities have estimated 331 people were killed in the earthquake and over 4,500 injured
